newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end at high, Skandia soars.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end at high, Skandia soars.

text.p: Share prices closed at record highs on Monday, cheered by a positive open on Wall Street. Gains looked set to continue, brokers said.
The bourse's general index ended at an all-time high of 3,114.12, up 1.36 percent in light turnover totalling 2.7 billion crowns.
Insurance company Skandia soared 19 crowns to 327, boosted by analysts upgrading the value of the group's U.S. unit-linked division, AFS.
Ericsson edged up 0.5 crown to 316 ahead of rival Motorola's earnings report due on Tuesday.
Drug company Astra rose 5.5 crowns to 156. Brokers said U.S. investment house Fidelity was buying the share.
